$comment: Four measures. Resist adding a fifth. Full definitions in docs/METRICS.md.

measures.label: the share
measures.help: This group as a percentage of the total for the same month.

guards.$comment: Below this, the share is suppressed and rendered as a greyed band. Stops early BEV percentages from looking like noise.

measures.label: the change on a year ago
measures.help: Compared with the same month last year. Avoids seasonal distortion.

measures.label: the 12-month running total
measures.formula: SUM(n) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
measures.help: Smooths out the March financial-year peak and rental fleet buying.

share_change_display.$comment: A move from 10% to 15% is +5pp, never +50%. Enforce this in the formatter, not per-chart.

derived_measures.label: the typical age of used imports
derived_measures.note: Used imports only. NZ-new age at registration is 0 by construction from 2007, so including NZ-new vehicles would restate the new/used mix, not measure age. vehicle_year is a year not a date, so this carries up to +/-1 year of granularity error. Never report to a decimal.

derived_measures.label: the used-import lag
derived_measures.note: Years between a model going on sale new in NZ and first appearing as a used import.
